en-US.author: Nenad Hrg
en-US.longDescription: The Quad-Directory-Explorer makes your files and folders easy to manage, either installed or as a Portable Windows program as an alternative Freeware to Windows File Explorer.
en-US.name: Q-Dir
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Update necessitated by a false-positive virus alert on the MS Windows.
- Performed solely for security reasons, even though no virus was actually present.
- Includes an update to language files and general optimizations.
